Synthesis of the zeolite: We started with an initial experimental factorial design (3 × 3 × 5; see the Supporting Information, Figure S2) in which Si/Ge, TIII/(Si + Ge), and F−/(Si + Ge) were the synthesis variables. Crystallization temperature and time were fixed at 175 °C and one day. The optimum synthesis gel composition was 0.67SiO2:0.33GeO2:0.05Al2O3:0.25SDAOH:0.20NH4F:0.05NH4Cl: 2H2O.

Synthesis of the structure-directing agent (SDA): (2′-(R),6′-(S))-2′,6′-dimethylspiro[isoindole-2,1′-piperidin-1′-ium] was obtained in a one-step reaction. 1,2-Bis(bromomethyl)benzene and cis-2,6-dimethylpiperidine were combined in a 1:1 molar ratio in the presence of K2CO3 and heated under reflux for two days. The bromide was converted into the hydroxide (SDAOH) by ion exchange.
